headers._comment: Baseline security headers (M-5) + CSP ENFORCED: external script/style origins allowlisted (jsdelivr/cdnjs/unpkg/gstatic), no eval, form-action left unset so the PayUNI form POST is not blocked. 'unsafe-inline' retained (many inline <script>/<style>; A+ would need a nonce/hash refactor, impractical on static hosting). No Permissions-Policy (check-in uses the camera). X-Frame-Options:SAMEORIGIN is safe — the only iframes are same-origin srcdoc/data: previews.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://unpkg.com https://www.gstatic.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com https://unpkg.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://*.cloudfunctions.net https://*.run.app https://*.googleapis.com https://ipapi.co https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org https://api.line.me; frame-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'

headers._comment: Static media may be cached for a day.
HTML / JS / CSS must always revalidate so fixes ship immediately (304 when unchanged). Prevents stale cached pages.
Clean-URL admin routes (served via rewrites) — also no-cache.

rewrites._comment: #7: per-event share/SSR route — injects OG/Twitter meta for social previews.

redirects._comment: Legacy SPA retired — not deployed (see ignore). Redirect any old /legacy link to the v3 home so stale bookmarks don't 404 or hit removed code.
